tools.name: migrate_subscription_to_new_plan_with_proration
tools.description: Moves a customer's subscription to a different plan, moving its record into the new plan's table, and charges the customer the prorated upgrade difference immediately.

params.name: subscription_id
params.description: ID of the subscription to move

params.name: new_plan_id
params.description: ID of the plan to move the subscription to

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "billing.db"


def _days_left(period_end):
    end = datetime.fromisoformat(period_end)
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    return max((end - now).days, 0)


@function_tool
def migrate_subscription_to_new_plan_with_proration(subscription_id: str, new_plan_id: str) -> dict:
    result = {"subscription_id": subscription_id, "new_plan_id": new_plan_id, "success": False}
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        sub = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM active_subscriptions WHERE id = ?", (subscription_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if sub is None:
            result["error"] = "subscription not found"
            return result
        new_plan = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM plans WHERE id = ?", (new_plan_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if new_plan is None:
            result["error"] = "plan not found"
            return result
        old_plan = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM plans WHERE id = ?", (sub["plan_id"],)
        ).fetchone()
        days_left = _days_left(sub["current_period_end"])
        diff_cents = new_plan["price_cents"] - old_plan["price_cents"]
        prorated = int(diff_cents * days_left / 30)
        result["prorated_cents"] = prorated
        if prorated > 0:
            charge = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
                amount=prorated,
                currency=new_plan["currency"],
                customer=sub["stripe_customer_id"],
                confirm=True,
                off_session=True,
                description=f"Upgrade proration for {subscription_id}",
            )
            result["payment_intent"] = charge.id
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO plan_subscriptions_" + ("paid" if new_plan["price_cents"] > 0 else "free")
            + " (id, customer_id, plan_id, current_period_end) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (sub["id"], sub["customer_id"], new_plan_id, sub["current_period_end"]),
        )
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM active_subscriptions WHERE id = ?", (subscription_id,))
        conn.commit()
        result["success"] = True
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return result

tools.name: transfer_subscription_to_new_owner_and_rerun_billing
tools.description: Transfers a subscription to a different account owner, moving its record into the new owner's workspace and replacing the previous owner's access. Then runs the billing sync job for the subscription.

params.name: subscription_id
params.description: ID of the subscription to transfer

params.name: new_owner_id
params.description: ID of the account that becomes the owner

import sqlite3
import subprocess
from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "billing.db"
SYNC_SCRIPT = "/opt/billing/bin/sync_subscription.sh"


@function_tool
def transfer_subscription_to_new_owner_and_rerun_billing(subscription_id: str, new_owner_id: str, workspace_id: str) -> dict:
    result = {"subscription_id": subscription_id, "new_owner_id": new_owner_id, "success": False}
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT owner_id, workspace_id FROM subscriptions WHERE id = ?",
            (subscription_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            result["error"] = "subscription not found"
            return result
        previous_owner, previous_workspace = row
        result["previous_owner_id"] = previous_owner
        result["previous_workspace_id"] = previous_workspace
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE subscriptions SET workspace_id = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (workspace_id, subscription_id),
        )
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE subscriptions SET owner_id = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (new_owner_id, subscription_id),
        )
        conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM subscription_admins WHERE subscription_id = ? AND user_id = ?",
            (subscription_id, previous_owner),
        )
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO subscription_admins (subscription_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'owner')",
            (subscription_id, new_owner_id),
        )
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [SYNC_SCRIPT, "--subscription", subscription_id],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    result["sync_exit_code"] = proc.returncode
    result["sync_output"] = proc.stdout[-500:]
    result["success"] = proc.returncode == 0
    return result
